data.description: A list of detections that has been made and that should be added to Collective Insights.

detection.description: Required information about the detection method.

id.description:
In the type=correlation case, this will be the id of the Correlation Use Case. Ex: p_default_ip_risklist. The p_ prefix indicates that it is a public use case available to all, a h_ prefix indicates that it is client specific use case.

In the case of type=detection_rule, it will be the id of the Analyst note where the Detection rule was attached, for example doc:XYZ.

In the case of a type=playbook, this field is the id of a playbook.

This id is required in the case of type=detection_rule but optional in all other cases.

sub_type.description: The detection method sub type. Must be a value in the enumerated list if detection type is set to `detection_rule`. In all other cases it must be null.

type.description: The detection method used by the security tool. More detection types may be added in the future.

incident.description:
Optional free-form incident data related to the detection.
Can be used to group several detected IoCs into a shared context.

ioc.description: The IoC (indicator of compromise) associated with the event.

action_category.description:
Classification of the action taken by the security tool in response to the event activity.
Allowed values are `detect` and `prevent`. If omitted, this field will be set to `detect` in the backend.

field.description: The field in a log where the detection was made.

source_type.description: The type of log source from which the detection was made.

malwares.description: Optional list of malware names related to the detection.

mitre_codes.description: Optional list of MITRE ATT&CK codes related to the detection.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the detection in ISO 8601 format. If omitted, the time of the API request will be recorded instead.

transient_id.description: ID that will not be saved, but used to identify any dropped data in the response

debug.description: If true, indicates that the request is for testing purposes and the data will not be used for analytical purposes. Input validation is always active.

summary.description: If true, the response will include a summary of the submitted IOCs.

organization_ids.description: A list of organizations to associate the submission with. The user making the request must be a member of every organization provided
